reviews.text:
I highly recommend Sapiens Dog! As first-time dog owners, my husband and I had no idea where to begin, and Gala was a huge help from day one. She guided us in preparing for our little one's arrival and helped us with all the basics, from housebreaking to helping her adjust to daily life: when and how to leave her alone, how to train her gradually, and how to establish good routines.

At first, our puppy was afraid to go outside and even to go for walks. Thanks to Gala's patience, training, and practical advice, she now loves going for walks! 🐶❤️

She's also always very attentive and available for any questions or needs that arise, which has been a huge help. I would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for support with their dog's training or behavior.

While researching dog trainers to help with various issues with my dog, I decided to contact sapiensdog because I liked her training philosophy. I've been working with her for a while now, and my dog ​​has not only improved in the area I was concerned about but in many other aspects as well. She's fully engaged both during the sessions and in the time between them. I couldn't be more grateful. And my dog ​​adores her.
Thanks Victor!! See you at the next dog training session!
A 100% recommendable experience. Very close attention. Great professionals Ari and Gala.
Very professional!! Totally recommended.
Thank you Marisol! Thank you very much for the rating! It helps us a lot to continue being a reference for friendly education in Barcelona. It makes us very happy to see your evolution. See you soon!
Very positive. I recommend it. The goals are achieved and the treatment of both the pets and the owners is excellent.
Very professional! Excellent treatment! You can tell they have a lot of love for dogs!

Thank you so much, Marta! Working on behavior modification from an emotional standpoint is what makes all the difference. Seeing Nemo calmer in a city like Barcelona is our greatest reward. We'll keep going!
Thank you very much for the 5 stars, Oriol! It helps us a lot to continue growing and offering the best dog education in Barcelona. A hug for you and a lick for your dog!

Super professionals!!
They know what they are doing, we have noticed many results! They also help to understand what dogs need, not just to educate them!
Thanks Ariadna and Gal•la!
Thank you, Martha!
Thank you for the treatment and all the tools to be able to generate a better bond with my little one. You are great professionals!
Thanks for the rating, Ona! It was a pleasure to have helped you with the education of your pet. See you soon in the parks of Barcelona!

Meeting Ari from Sapiens Dog changed my dog ​​Branco's life, and mine too. She helped me understand him, teach him to think, manage his emotions, and make better decisions. Her approach, based on respect and empathy, not only transformed our relationship but inspired me so much that I ended up becoming her student. She's authentic, passionate, and an incredible mentor. I wholeheartedly recommend her!

Since bringing Maçã home at three months old, Ariadna has been helping us build a healthy and stable relationship with her. Ariadna has been a wonderful guide, teaching us how to redirect Maçã's misbehavior in a way that is appropriate for her age and developmental stage. She has always been willing to answer our questions and has proven to be very organized, sending us a summary of the points covered in each session. We are so grateful for her help and recommend her without reservation!

We had a training session for our puppy Colchón and it was very helpful! We tweaked our training approach a bit, and the results were excellent! Our puppy was refusing to relieve himself outside, but after taking him on shorter, more frequent walks, as suggested, and without forcing him to stay outside, he became more comfortable during walks and, over time, started doing his business outside on his own.

Excellent experience with Ari! Zazpi is a generally calm dog, but we needed professional help to manage his reactivity at certain times and to better understand the specific behaviors of the breed (Border Collie and Podenco mix).
Ari has helped us understand the origin of his behaviors and has also given us practical tools and effective advice to help Zazpi.
We have noticed a significant improvement in his calmness and well-being. Highly recommended!

My name is Montse and my family and I have Boira. A Belgian Malinois shepherd that we took in because she was abandoned.
We had a lot of work with her and we contacted Ariadna.
She is a very good professional who we have to thank for a good job. Now Boira is another dog. Thank you very much Ariadna. 100% recommended.

Excellent experience. Super professional. She helped us a lot with our dog Foo's everyday behavior. It was exactly what we were looking for—not to teach her tricks, but to train her for daily life. Ari does it with so much love and dedication. I highly recommend her.

Ariadna helped me understand my dog ​​better and how to deal with a Dachshund's stubbornness.
She also gave me great advice about the false pregnancy she experienced.

This is my first time with a puppy, and I decided to ask for help. I'm so happy and much calmer now. Ariadna helped me manage things at home, and now we're working on walks outside. She helped me structure walks and organize my puppy's day in a balanced way. We still have a lot of work to do, but little by little, and with the help of great professionals, we'll achieve everything. Highly recommended!

Thank you Ariadna and Gal•la for your amazing work!

If you're looking for dedicated, professional dog trainers with a respectful and effective approach, don't hesitate to contact them. We are so grateful at home; we have a Belgian Shepherd who isn't exactly easy to handle, and since she was a puppy, we've learned so much about understanding her, managing her needs, and working on her behavior. Thank you for your patience!
They have helped me a lot with my dog ​​Bruno.
Everything was fantastic. Ari helped us a lot with our dog in a friendly and approachable way.

If you are looking for someone to help you understand your dog, look for Sapiengsdog.

The sessions are very beneficial and there is a before and after in the relationship with the dog, since thanks to everything that Ari teaches you, you can accompany him in the best way.

Thank you very much for everything we are learning with you and Cooper <3
They are true professionals. They genuinely love and understand dogs, and that's reflected in their attentive, personalized, and effective service.

Thank you so much, Claudia! Starting out with a puppy can be intense, but you've laid a fantastic foundation for its future. I'm so glad my help has allowed you to enjoy it more. See you at the next session!
Thanks to Ari, both my dog ​​and I can go out for walks again in peace. Highly recommended!!
Thanks, Carlos!
Thank you, Nayra!

Thank you for your help, Ariadna.

I recommend your service to anyone who wants kind and respectful training for their animals.
Thank you, Itsaso!
Thank you for valuing our work, Niku! At Sapiens Dog, we work to ensure you enjoy a peaceful and happy life together. Thank you for trusting our gentle training!
Thank you so much, Patri! Reviews like yours encourage us to continue offering the best in-home dog training service based on respect and animal welfare. Best regards!
Behavioral approach based on dog obedience. It's good but not for all dogs.
Thanks girls! Duende arrived very stressed from the shelter and little by little with Ari's guidelines we see him much more balanced. Totally recommended

I contacted Ari because my dog ​​Britney had a really hard time every time she was left home alone. After doing sessions with other trainers and it didn't work, Ari finally hit the nail on the head. Britney can stay home in peace. We are very happy with the process and the love with which Ari accompanied us.

Since we started training with Ariadna, we've noticed a huge improvement in our dog, Sky. Before, she was a very stressed dog; she didn't sleep, barked a lot at home and outside, was very reactive, and wouldn't stay alone for even five minutes. Now she doesn't bark at home, sleeps very well, her walks are calm, and she's already interacted with some dogs and can now stay alone for an hour. We had tried three trainers before Ariadna, and every day we're more grateful to have found her.

I fell in love with Sapiens Dog's approach to helping dogs and especially the understanding of the suffering that can be behind their "aggressive" behaviors. I'm glad I decided to seek help for my dog ​​and the truth is that we are much better <3 Thank you for everything!
